// ==========================================================================
// THE Cola SET'S MODELS -- one block per gun, binding its mesh to the prop its card names.
//
// GENERATED by _pending/tools/make_modeldef.py from WMCARD.cola's OWN model and skin lines, so
// the two cannot disagree about which file a gun draws. They did once: the card moved onto
// _wm meshes while this still named the originals, which packs models nothing addresses and
// draws nothing, with no error anywhere. DO NOT EDIT -- change the card and run it again.
//
// WMPR is the reload system's one-pixel prop sprite -- the frame WM_Prop's Spawn state
// carries, and what every prop block in the base pack binds. A name with no sprite lump
// behind it is a MODELDEF reference to nothing.
// ==========================================================================
